name: Immunology
summary: How the body tells self from non-self: innate and adaptive immunity, antibodies, T cells, vaccines and immune disorders.

topics.name: Overview of the immune system: cells, organs and lymphatics
Innate immunity: barriers, phagocytes, complement and inflammation
Generation of diversity: V(D)J recombination, somatic hypermutation and class switching
MHC and antigen processing and presentation
T-cell development, thymic selection and tolerance
T-cell activation and effector subsets (Th1, Th2, Th17, Treg, cytotoxic T cells)
B-cell activation and the germinal centre
Immunotherapy: monoclonal antibodies, checkpoint blockade and CAR-T cells
